basic_info.description: Incredible opportunity! This is a beautiful duplex that truly shows pride of ownership. Upper unit features 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, large open floor plan with chef kitchen. Primary bedroom suite has 2 sinks, shower stall, and tub. There is also a laundry room in this fabulous unit. Lower flat offers very spacious 2 bedrooms 2 full bathrooms with primary bedroom suite. Sparkling hardwood floors throughout. Elegant formal living and dining rooms with remodeled kitchen. There is also access to garden level from this unit, where there is a large room and bath with tall ceiling heights. Rm & ba were permitted according to 3R report. Garden is accessible from breezeway. Garage can park 2 small  cars. Depends on size of car. This building is semi detached, therefore its flooded with natural light. These units have great scale, lovely period details and good bones. Both units are owner occupied and can be delivered vacant. Awesome location close to USF, transportations, park and shopping.
